## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** the mechanism described in the PR is supported by the Hyprland 0.56.2 source, and the focus gate works as described on a single output. Multi-output setups lose keyboard focus in a way `Ui/KeyboardPanel.qml` avoids, because the per-output dismissal surfaces that go with its OnDemand switch are not included here.

**Verified (source review):**
- While a layer surface is Exclusive, Hyprland hit-tests only the exclusive surfaces before any other layer (`InputManager.cpp`, the "forced above all" block), and touch goes through the same `refocus` path. A surface stacked above the overlay therefore cannot receive pointer or touch input. Switching to OnDemand removes the surface from that list (`LayerSurface.cpp`) without a keyboard leave, so typing is not interrupted at the 75 ms switch.
- Quickshell 0.3.1 destroys and recreates the layer window on every hide/show, so each open gets a fresh Exclusive prime. Closing stops a pending timer, `onTriggered` rechecks the gate, and `focusPrimed` cannot stay true while the gate is false.
- Escape, typing, navigation and the full-screen outside-click `MouseArea`s are unchanged in all four files. The image picker keeps its `opened && imagesLoaded` gate.

### Keyboard focus moves to other monitors once the overlay settles on OnDemand

`KeyboardPanel.qml` pairs the Exclusive-then-OnDemand switch with a `Variants` over `Quickshell.screens` that puts a transparent, `WlrKeyboardFocus.None` dismissal surface on every other output. Its comment says these must "catch the pointer without taking focus from the panel when the cursor merely crosses onto their output". The four overlays here get the focus switch but not those surfaces.

With Omarchy's `follow_mouse = 1` (`default/hypr/input.lua`), once the overlay is OnDemand nothing blocks pointer-driven refocus (`InputManager::mouseMoveUnified`), and `FocusState::rawWindowFocus` only refuses window focus while an exclusive layer exists.

Overlay open on output A, pointer moves onto an application window on output B (from source, default follow-mouse path):

| | Before this PR (Exclusive) | This PR, after 75 ms (OnDemand) | `KeyboardPanel` (OnDemand + dismissal surfaces) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyboard focus | stays on overlay | moves to the app on B | stays on panel |
| Click on B | routed to the exclusive overlay, not the app | reaches the app on B; overlay stays open | caught by the dismissal surface; panel closes |
| Typing / Enter | overlay search | app on B | panel |

**Impact:** on a multi-monitor setup, the menu, clipboard, emoji or image picker can stay open on one screen while keystrokes intended for its search, including Enter, go to an application on another screen. Moving the pointer back over the overlay restores focus. Keybind-driven focus changes (workspace switch, `movefocus`) are also no longer refused after the 75 ms prime, on any output. `KeyboardPanel` accepts that trade-off too, but these four are full-screen modal pickers. The PR notes multi-output was not tested. This analysis is also source-only, and window rules such as `no_follow_mouse`, pointer grabs or captured input can change the timing.

**Suggested change:** add the per-output dismissal surfaces alongside the prime, for example by extracting the prime and the `Variants` block from `KeyboardPanel.qml` into one shared component, as the description already offers. Alternatively, document the multi-output trade-off explicitly.

**Description notes:**
- The Scope section lists `plugins/reminders/ReminderFlow.qml`, `plugins/panels/wifiqr/Panel.qml` and `Ui/SpeedTestOverlay.qml` with the same stock setting, but the diff leaves them on Exclusive, and only polkit and lock are described as intentional exclusions. Stating whether those three are deferred would clarify the scope.
- In-panel menu submenu navigation (`setActiveMenu`) does not change `panel.visible`, so it does not re-run the prime as the Tested section states. Focus simply stays on the open panel. Only closing and reopening the menu primes again.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of the four changed files, `Ui/KeyboardPanel.qml` and Omarchy's default Hyprland input configuration, against Hyprland 0.56.2 and Quickshell 0.3.1 source. No runtime, multi-monitor, touch or on-screen keyboard tests were run. Multi-output behavior is derived from source for the default follow-mouse path.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
